detail.longDescription: THE LIMITATIONS OF MILITARY SIMULATIONS: DATA, CREATION, AND THE DIVINE There is a fundamental distinction between simulating reality and creating something genuinely new. Military simulations, regardless of their technological sophistication, are representative of the information, variables, assumptions, and historical data supplied to them. They can calculate outcomes, reproduce scenarios, identify patterns, and project possibilities based on the information available within their operating environments.
